title: a draft cannot use the id of a saved build, so an agent cannot shadow an approved build with its own draft
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). A draft needs an id that no saved build has: `JITSO REJECTED: build "<id>" already exists (<layer> <display path>): a draft needs an id no build has`, exit 2, nothing written. The ids of two different saved builds of the project are both refused. A draft never shadows a saved build.
